description: Assembly source code for Xtensa architecture, including register spilling, context switching, exception handling, and interrupt vectors.

methods.name: xtensa_spill_reg_windows
methods.description: Spills all register windows; not a C function, entered via CALL0.

methods.name: xtensa_save_high_regs
methods.description: Saves high A4-A15 registers to the stack, used during context save.

methods.name: xtensa_restore_high_regs
methods.description: Restores high A4-A15 registers from the stack, used during context restore.

methods.name: xtensa_switch
methods.description: Performs a context switch between saved states.

methods.name: xtensa_arch_except
methods.description: Handles hardware exceptions, saving context and exception reason.

methods.name: xtensa_arch_kernel_oops
methods.description: Raises a hardware exception for kernel oops.
